# Chillers (ElectricChiller, AbsorptionChiller)

## ElectricChiller

> **Class**: `ElectricChiller` | **Module**: `energysim.models.hvac_thermal` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

### Overview

Electric vapor-compression chiller.

COP changes linearly with ambient temperature (-1.5 % per K above 25 C and
+1.5 % per K below it) and is clamped to [2, 8]; it is evaluated continuously, also when idle.
Validity: T_amb 5..45 C, constant-COP part-load behaviour.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'ElectricChiller'` | - | Unique component name identifier |
| `q_cooling_max_mw` | `float` | `5.0` | MW | - |
| `cop_nominal` | `float` | `5.5` | - | Design Coefficient of Performance |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

### Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Q_cool_cmd_MW` | MW | - |
| `T_amb` | degC | - |

### Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_elec_MW` | MW | - |
| `Q_cool_actual_MW` | MW | - |
| `COP` | 1 | - |

### Validity and notes

Validity: T_amb 5..45 C, constant-COP part-load behaviour.

### Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import ElectricChiller

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('electricchiller', model=ElectricChiller(), outputs=['P_elec_MW', 'Q_cool_actual_MW', 'COP'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['electricchiller'].tail(2))
```

## AbsorptionChiller

> **Class**: `AbsorptionChiller` | **Module**: `energysim.models.hvac_thermal` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

### Overview

Waste-heat / steam driven absorption chiller.
Replaces electricity with thermal heat to produce chilled water.

Constant thermal COP; cooling is limited by capacity and by the available
waste heat (heat consumed = cooling / COP). No electrical parasitics.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'AbsorptionChiller'` | - | Unique component name identifier |
| `q_cooling_max_mw` | `float` | `5.0` | MW | - |
| `cop_thermal` | `float` | `0.85` | - | - |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

### Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Q_cool_cmd_MW` | MW | - |
| `Q_waste_heat_available_MW` | MW | - |

### Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Q_cool_actual_MW` | MW | - |
| `Q_heat_consumed_MW` | MW | Waste heat consumed (Absorption Chiller) |

### Validity and notes

Validity: constant thermal COP independent of source and sink temperatures; cooling between 0 and
q_cooling_max_mw, limited by the available waste heat; steady state.

### Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import AbsorptionChiller

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('absorptionchiller', model=AbsorptionChiller(), outputs=['Q_cool_actual_MW', 'Q_heat_consumed_MW'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['absorptionchiller'].tail(2))
```
